input: Book a sunset sailing trip for the group

gold.taskTitle: Book a Sunset Sailing Trip for the Group
gold.taskDescription: Research and book a sunset sailing trip for a group of people at a chosen location and date.

questions.title: How many people are joining the sailing trip?
questions.description: Determine the total headcount so the right vessel size or charter capacity can be found.

questions.title: What city or waterway should the trip depart from?
questions.description: Identify the specific departure location to narrow down available charter companies and routes.

questions.title: What date or date range are you targeting?
questions.description: Pinpoint the preferred sailing date or window of dates to check availability.

questions.title: What is the total budget for the entire group?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to filter charter options by price tier.

questions.title: Is this a private charter or an open shared cruise?
questions.description: Clarify whether the group wants exclusive use of the boat or is comfortable sharing with strangers.

questions.title: Should food and drinks be included on board?
questions.description: Determine catering preferences so packages with or without refreshments can be compared.

questions.title: What is the occasion or purpose of this trip?
questions.description: Understand the reason behind the trip to tailor the experience, such as a birthday, corporate event, or casual outing.
